extracted.intended_audience: prospective SOSP 2025 authors, presenters, and conference attendees (researchers, developers, programmers, and teachers in computer systems)
extracted.subtask_description: Information and procedural requirements for submitting papers, posters, artifacts, and workshop/tutorial proposals to SOSP 2025, plus key dates for review, notification, and registration. Focused on prospective authors and organizers preparing materials for the conference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of acceptable submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Academic and industrial participants present research and experience papers that cover the full range of theory and practice of computer systems software.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target audience includes researchers, developers, programmers, and teachers of computer systems technology; submissions should fit within theory and practice of computer systems software.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission deadline (no extensions)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions are handled via HotCRP. The deadline is firm—no extensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadline to register abstracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Deadline to register abstracts: April 10, 2025; 23:59 PT
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Abstract registration likely via HotCRP (link given). Authors should register abstracts by this date prior to full submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviews available for author response
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviews available for author response: July 1, 2025
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors will receive reviews by this date to prepare a short response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author response due
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors have a limited window (from reviews available to this date) to submit author responses; use the HotCRP workflow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author notification
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Final decisions (accept/reject) will be communicated to authors on this date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Artifact intent registration date
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See sysartifacts for details; authors planning to submit artifacts should register intent by this date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Artifact submission deadline
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Actual artifact materials are due on this date; refer to the sysartifacts page for submission format and requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Camera-ready deadline
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors of accepted papers must submit final camera-ready versions by this date via HotCRP (or specified system).

rubrics_metrics.name: Poster submission and notification
rubrics_metrics.description: Poster submission deadline: September 7, 2025 (previously September 1, 2025); Poster acceptance notification: September 15, 2025 (previously September 8, 2025)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Poster submissions have a separate deadline and notification schedule; follow Poster HotCRP link for submission instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Student Research Competition (SRC) timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: SRC submission due: August 15, 2025; SRC notification: September 15, 2025
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SRC entrants must meet the SRC submission date (link: SRC HotCRP) and will be notified on the listed date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel grant and scholarship deadlines/notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Student scholarship and Travel grant application deadline: September 1, 2025; Travel grant notification: September 22, 2025 (previously September 15, 2025)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants for travel support must apply by the stated deadline; notification of awards will follow on the listed date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workshop/Tutorial proposal timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Workshop/Tutorial Proposals Due: April 29, 2025 (previously April 15, 2025); Workshop/Tutorial Notification of Acceptance: May 4, 2025 (previously April 20, 2025)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should be submitted by the due date; notifications are on the listed acceptance date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Early registration deadline and conference dates
rubrics_metrics.description: Early registration deadline: September 8, 2025 (previously September 1, 2025); Conference: October 14 - 16, 2025; Workshop: October 13, 2025
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attendees wishing to register at early rates should meet the early-registration deadline; note full conference and workshop dates and plan travel/registration accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conference contact for organizational questions
rubrics_metrics.description: Any organizational questions about the conference can be emailed to sosp25gc@kaist.ac.kr
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this contact address for logistical or organizational inquiries related to SOSP 2025.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission system references
rubrics_metrics.description: Several submission and workflow steps reference HotCRP; artifact details reference sysartifacts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors and submitters must use HotCRP for paper/poster/SRC submissions and follow the sysartifacts page for artifact registration/submission details.
